Docs.summary: Provides classes to configure and manage virtual carrier networks (VCNs).

remarks.para: Use and to describe a VCN and its gateway connections. Network templates prioritize eligible underlying cellular and Wi-Fi networks. An otherwise eligible carrier-owned underlying network can still be selected when no template matches. manages configurations for subscription groups and registers callbacks for status changes and gateway errors.
See the Android VCN package reference for the platform API.
